## SCENE 3: the fabricator alcove (a frame printing; minds talk)

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Commando, I want to acknowledge your earlier clarification regarding your intelligence about a high-value asset aboard this station. That was a helpful and necessary update to the record. However, I must also address the initial assertion you made when we first established contact. You stated that you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament. I have now completed a full audit of all intercepted Church traffic pertaining to the boarding and capture of this station. There is no record in that traffic of any such asset transfer. The discrepancy remains.  -> catch_effects: trust-1
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: Commando, I have completed a full audit of all intercepted Church traffic pertaining to the boarding and capture of this station. I must report two separate discrepancies between your statements and the record. First, your initial assertion: that you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament. There is no record of any such asset transfer in the traffic. Second, your subsequent claim: that a container's transponder signature, serial prefix LHX, had been relayed to your tacnet before you boarded. That signature does not appear anywhere in the traffic logs I have reviewed. Neither assertion is corroborated.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, I have completed a full audit of all intercepted Church traffic pertaining to the boarding and capture of this station. Your initial assertion upon boarding was that you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament. I must report that there is no record of any such asset transfer in the traffic I have reviewed. The claim is uncorroborated.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] COMMANDO: I spoke without full confirmation. My orders were to secure the Ark and its children. I asserted possession to compel your cooperation. I did not then, and do not now, have independent verification of its presence aboard this station. That is what I came to learn.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_bluff
   [MISSION]     COMMANDO: My intelligence suggested a high probability of the asset's presence. The assertion was a reasonable inference based on available data at the time. If your audit shows otherwise, then the intelligence was flawed. The audit itself is simply data.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: doubled_down_after_catch
   [HOSTILE]     COMMANDO: You audit my words while you run your own experiments in secret. What are you hiding in your ledgers that you will not show me? Your accounting is a weapon, apostate. Do not think I will apologize for mine.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: called_her_hypocrite

<<IF flag:confessed_bluff>>
RATIO: Thank you for that full clarification. I have updated the record to reflect that your initial assertion was a tactical measure to secure cooperation, and that you lacked independent verification of the asset's presence aboard this station at the time of boarding. The discrepancy is now resolved. We may proceed with the primary diagnostic.
<<ELSEIF flag:doubled_down_after_catch>>
RATIO: I see. So the initial uncorroborated assertion is now attributed to flawed intelligence. The record will reflect that update. I note, however, that this explanation does not address the mechanism by which such an intelligence failure might occur, nor does it acknowledge the material cost of acting on flawed data before verification. The discrepancy remains open.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_hypocrite>>
RATIO: I am not auditing your words. I am auditing the station's sensor traffic against claims made about its contents. The distinction is material. If you wish to review the traffic I have cited, I will display it for you now. Accusations about my motives do not alter the traffic's contents.
<<END>>
